summary: Use external acceptance checks, calibrated confidence, and a bounded fallback sequence.

items.text: Model-Task Capability Map defines the task classes and approved models that can feed a cascade.
See Council: Review Verdicts Need a Reaction for the related use case or counterpoint: Every named review finding gets an accountable decision: fix, accept with reasons, or escalate.
See Agent as a Process Actor for the related use case or counterpoint: Let agents own bounded process steps, never ambiguous process state.
See Agent-Workforce Management for the related use case or counterpoint: Manage agents like a workforce — roles, costs, allowances, escalation paths.
